item.title: creating instead of consuming
item.description: Relaxing by creating Chris Lakin had this great post back in the day (archived here) about relaxing by creating instead of by consuming. I haven’t read it in a while, but it still lingers on account of both my bad habit of poor quality relaxation and my related media consumption addiction.

item.title: projects
item.description: A number of projects that I’ve started or thought of at some point or another. I don’t care for getting scooped so if you’re interested, please go ahead and do them! Then, do tell me about it so that I can thank you / ask you about how it went.

item.title: fog-of-war chess
item.description: What is Fog of War Chess? Fog-of-war chess is by far, my favorite game in the world. Fog-of-war is a variant of chess (available on chess.com) where you are only able to see the squares your pieces are or where your pieces can move.

item.description: Some advice, I’ll update this occasionally. Note that I think most advice applies to everyone. Some people say all advice is bad, to them I say this isn’t advice despite being titled advice, and is instead just reminders of obvious facts about the world.

item.title: RSI
item.description: Defining RSI What is RSI?? I think it means that humans exit the loop of AI development. But like … how much? It could be the case that humans are cheaper than automated alternatives for a large variety of physical labor for some time.
